verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a public REST API with clear authentication: private keys with scopes, OAuth for partners, and public keys for client-side calls. Reference docs cover concrete endpoints such as creating campaigns, creating events and listing webhooks, and there is published rate-limit header behavior. It also ships official SDKs in several languages, a Postman collection and test accounts for safe experimentation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can drive the API end-to-end.
